reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
scope: Two previously untracked non-incretin oral programmes found through topic-based discovery. Existing PR #882 retains the prepared publication; #868 remains the discovery review queue.

candidates.name: SYNT-101
candidates.summary: Investigational oral therapy intended to form a temporary duodenal lining. Syntis reported exploratory hormone and weight findings in the 23-person, 28-day multiple-dose portion of SYNTIETY-1. The full registered Phase 1 study enrolled 55 participants. Human muscle-preservation benefit is not established; supporting muscle findings were in rodents.
candidates.limitations: Small early trial; no established equivalence to surgery or GLP-1 medicines. Detailed conference presentation was planned for November 2026, not already completed.

candidates.name: CRB-913
candidates.stage: Phase 1b results reported; Phase 2 planned for first half of 2027
candidates.summary: Investigational oral peripheral CB1 inverse agonist. Corbus reported CANYON-1 results in 254 adults without diabetes after 12 weeks of treatment. Adverse-event discontinuations ranged from 3.1% to 13.1%. Psychiatric adverse events occurred, including one transient moderate depressive symptom. Registry status remains active, not recruiting.
candidates.limitations: Sponsor results and older registry are not fully aligned: registry lists 252 estimated participants and estimated July 2026 completion. Cross-trial comparisons with GLP-1 drugs do not establish better tolerability. Phase 2 and combination studies are not claimed to have begun.
